jobs.title: Systemutvecklare Fullstack
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning

AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.

Jobbeskrivning

Är du en helt vanlig eller ovanlig back-end-utvecklare, som vill ha roligt på jobbet, samarbeta med andra, bidra med din kompetens, ha en stöttande chef och vara del av ett riktigt härligt team i Enköping?
Bra, för precis det kan vi erbjuda dig!

I din roll som konsult kommer du att vara ansvarig för att utveckla och underhålla back-end-komponenter i olika projekt. Rollen innebär att arbeta både självständigt och i team, t.ex. genom att ensam eller tillsammans med kollegor ta ansvar för hela back-end-delen av ett projekt.

Vi driver både små och stora projekt från Enköping och har kunder inom flera olika branscher, t.ex. offentlig sektor och samhällsviktig verksamhet. Din vardag kommer se lite olika ut beroende på projekt, kund och uppdrag - och den variationen tror jag att du tycker känns kul!

Kvalifikationer

Dina tekniska färdigheter är förstås viktiga men vad du har att bidra med som person är lika viktigt det. I den här rollen behöver du t.ex. trivas med att samarbeta i team och dela ut och ta emot feedback, tycka att det är intressant när omständigheter förändras (t.ex. att du behöver lära dig en ny teknik eller nya arbetsuppgifter, byta kund, team eller projekt etc.), du motiveras av att hjälpa andra (t.ex. föreslå en teknisk förändring som är till hjälp för kunden) och du drar dig inte för att själv ta hjälp om du kör fast.

För att komma in med rätt tekniska förutsättningar tror vi att du:

Har minst 3 års erfarenhet av C#/.NET-utveckling
Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med REST API:er
Har erfarenhet av Azure och kunskap om DevOps och dess processer
Har erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server

Meriterande:

Erfarenhet av WPF
Erfarenhet av containerteknik (Podman, Kubernetes)
Erfarenhet av testdriven utveckling (TDD)
Erfarenhet av GIS

Utöver det är du svensk medborgare* och behärskar svenska i tal och skrift, då svenska krävs i kontakt med kollegor och kunder. Ett extra plus i kanten om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som konsult!

För vissa uppdrag hos myndighet, region eller kommun krävs svenskt medborgarskap och godkänd säkerhetsprövning.

Ytterligare information

Välkommen med din ansökan, sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-30

Kontaktperson för frågor:

Rebecka Gravås
, Gruppchef

rebecka.gravas@afry.com

Tel: 072 205 8117

Om rekryteringsprocessen:

I alla våra rekryteringsprocesser använder vi oss av kompetensbaserad rekrytering - för en rättvis och träffsäker rekrytering. Följande steg ingår i den här processen:

Telefonavstämning eller urvalsfrågor
1:a intervju (rekryterande chef)
Tekniskt test
2:a intervju (testuppföljning/teknisk intervju)
Referenstagning
Erbjudande

Läs gärna mer om hur vi arbetar med rekrytering på vår hemsida här: Rekryteringsprocessen på AFRY

Vad erbjuder vi dig?

En attraktiv arbetsmiljö med fokus på trivsel och utveckling. Du får utvecklas kontinuerligt genom uppdrag, utbildning och individuella kompetensplaner.
Konkurrenskraftiga villkor med förmåner som kollektivavtal, friskvård, företagsrabatter, pensionsplanering och generösa föräldraledighetsregler.
Ett stort nätverk av kompetenta kollegor i Sverige och internationellt.

Jag berättar gärna mer om våra förmåner under en intervju!

Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
💡 What We Do

Swiftly gaining ground as Sweden’s industry leader in battery storage and expanding rapidly in selected European markets, Flower is on a mission to enable the energy system of tomorrow. With an industry-leading AI-powered platform at its core, our service includes stabilizing the energy system by enhancing predictability and flexibility for both energy producers and consumers. By combining pioneering technology with a portfolio of flexible energy assets, we break new ground towards a fossil-free energy system, allowing clean energy to power society.

🌟 Who We Are

Tech company at heart – purpose in our DNA. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world. At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.

To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled Senior Software Engineer.

👩‍💻 About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Flower, you will be at the forefront of the energy transformation. You will work on systems that manage energy flexibility, integrating cutting-edge software solutions to enhance efficiency and reliability. You will collaborate with a high-performing, cross-functional team and guide them on their path towards finding a solution. You will help ensure system reliability, security, and performance through best coding practices and architecture decisions.

What You’ll Do

Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable software solutions for our energy platform.
Work with technologies such as Go, AWS, IoT Core and Databricks.
Build and optimize high-performance backend services and data processing pipelines as well as a fleet of IoT devices.
Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and other engineers from across the organisation.
Lead code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and mentoring other engineers.
Be an active part of the culture, with focus on continuous improvement and technical and operational excellence.

Who You Are

You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, working with backend development and distributed systems.
Proficient in Go, with experience in designing scalable services and APIs.
Hands-on experience with communication protocols such as MQTT, Modbus, and IEC104.
Familiarity with AI development tools and practices as they evolve.
Experience with modern DevOps principles such as CI/CD, IaC, and observability tooling like OpenTelemetry.
Passionate about working on impactful projects that contribute to a sustainable future.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with an ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

📍 Location

Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.

✉️ Apply

Our corporate language is English, as we have about 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will meet with the Talent Partner, the Head of Asset Integration, the Team, and the VP of Engineering. We look forward to hearing from you!

We kindly but firmly decline any engagement in recruitment assistance for our hiring processes. This includes partnership offers or the sale of recruitment tools.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Infrastructure Engineer to build and operate critical backend infrastructure for service discovery, traffic management, and service-to-service authentication in a large-scale production environment.

Location:
Stockholm
Duration -
9-10 months + extensions

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop backend infrastructure and distributed systems using Java.
Work with gRPC, Kubernetes/GKE, service discovery, load balancing, and failure handling.
Implement traffic-management capabilities including zone-aware routing, regional failover, and capacity-aware spillover.
Improve observability, metrics, troubleshooting, and production reliability.
Plan and execute large-scale migrations with safe validation and rollback strategies.
Lead design reviews and contribute to architectural decisions.

K ey Requirements

5+ years of backend or infrastructure engineering experience.
Strong Java experience building and operating production services/shared libraries.
Strong understanding of distributed systems.
Production experience with GCP and Kubernetes/GKE.
Hands-on gRPC and Kubernetes experience.
Strong debugging and performance optimisation skills.
Experience safely rolling out infrastructure changes across multiple services/teams.
Strong English communication skills.

Nice to Have

xDS, Envoy, service mesh, authentication, mTLS, and workload identity.

jobs.title: Masters Thesis Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Contract: 6-month internship

Start Date: Late January 2027

Work Model: Hybrid (3 days minimum onsite)

The Challenge Ahead

Frostbite is EA’s proprietary game engine, powering many of our leading titles across EA SPORTS, Battlefield, and more. We develop shared tools and technologies that connect and empower creators throughout EA. On Frostbite, you’ll collaborate with accomplished teams and contribute to the foundation that enables the creation of immersive, high-quality games for players worldwide.

As a Master's Thesis Intern, you will develop a project in an area where Frostbite's engineering efficiency can be multiplied with generative AI, agents, or context engineering. You will also gain an understanding of what it's like to work at EA. An open application means that you can provide ideas for what you want to work on, but we can also explore this together, based on your experiences and interests.

Responsibilities

You will investigate and prototype applying GenAI solutions to Frostbite's development process.
You will review designs and implementations with other software engineers and will validate your results using a representative dataset.
You will report to an engineering manager, attend meetings, present progress information and write a final report.

Eligibility

You are pursuing a MsC. in Computer Science (or a related field).
You are associated with a university education or any other type of education in Sweden that has an internship period planned into the education plan.

Skills

You have experience with Python, C# or C++.
You understand software development processes.
You have an interest in applying GenAI to software engineering (e.g. GitHub, CoPilot).
You have knowledge of AI concepts like knowledge graphs, vector databases, context engineering, MCP servers, LangChain, or RAG.
You understand software quality, test automation, or CI/CD.

Help us make play happen. Apply now with an up-to-date CV and Cover Letter in English, explaining what project you would like to work on and explain your pick based on your interests and skills.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.
